messages:
jules: Packaging update: prepared airgap installer bundle for private/vpc target (tag=release-2026-03-21-a1). Planning to run final seal + transport upload during change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Need ops thumbs-up and docs link before we publish.
omar: Are we keeping the previous manifest handy for quick pointer swap? Also what's the canonical rollback tag?
ravi: Yes, previous manifest archived as `archives/installer-2026-03-14-stable`. Rollback plan = atomically repoint `private-manifest` pointer to that tag. Trigger conditions documented below.
ops-cam: Window OK from ops. Two caveats: 1) mirror replication must finish within 18m after upload or we abort; 2) we need an explicit abort command in the deploy runbook that the deploy-bot can call.
artifact-bot: artifact-bot: size report produced: uncompressed = 8.1GB, zstd-delta = 3.7GB. Checksums: sha256:a9f2...3c4e.
artifact-bot: ```sha256: a9f2b4c3d1e5f67890ab1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2
size_bytes: 3978234880
```
jules: Good that zstd gets us under 4GB. Prefer single-file. If any middle-mile mirror complains we switch to two-part tar with part checksums.
omar: Signing question: are we using the primary cosign key or the rotated key from last month? Need to note in release notes.
ravi: Using rotated key: projects/prod/cosign/key-2026-02. Signed artifact metadata will include key id.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checklist scheduled at 02:40 UTC. Steps automated: build -> run unit preflight -> sign -> upload to private-edge -> verify -> publish pointer to staging-manifest (not `private-manifest` yet). CI command: ```./ci/release.sh --bundle release-2026-03-21-a1 --sign --verify```
ops-cam: Canary rollout plan: enable to 1.5% of private traffic for 15 minutes. Abort if error rate >= 0.8% sustained for 3 minutes OR latency p95 regression >200ms. On abort: immediately revert pointer and notify #incident-release.
jules: Docs: I'll add an ops note on KMS config and an upgrade snippet for on-prem customers. Link will be posted before publish.
omar: Also adding a short procedure to rotate cosign keys and re-verify signatures in the runbook.
ravi: Packaging note: we will keep immutable image tags. We update `private-latest` only after canary passes and SRE signoff.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: uploading now (started 03:02 UTC). Current upload progress: 35% to first-edge node.
artifact-bot: artifact-bot: cosign signature attached: cosign:sha256:ff12d3...ab34cd
ops-cam: Watch for upload stalls. If any single edge node stalls >8m we'll pause and fallback to alternate mirror set.
jules: Preflight logs: https://ci.internal/logs/release-3245678901. No blocking errors.
omar: Release notes draft: https://go/release-notes/priv-20260321. Add note about offline install verification steps.
ops-cam: Confirmed all checks green. After canary we expect to promote pointer to `private-manifest` at +30m.
ravi: Final: if anything fails during the delivery we follow the rollback checklist: 1) publish pointer revert, 2) disable canary traffic, 3) open incident and run hotpatch plan.
jules: Shipping now. Will mark in the docs once `private-manifest` is flipped. If we need to abort: call the runbook and ping #oncall immediately.
